# Wololo Converter

> Wololo Converter downloads videos (MP4) and audio (MP3) from public links on YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Twitter/X, Threads and Facebook. One GET request with the video URL is enough to ask for a download.

Base URL: https://wololo.edilson.dev
OpenAPI contract: https://wololo.edilson.dev/api/openapi.json

## Supported links

- YouTube: watch, shorts, live (ended streams only), youtu.be, embed
- Instagram: posts, reels, TV, share links
- TikTok: video pages, vm/vt short links
- Twitter/X: status links
- Threads: post and share links
- Facebook: video pages, watch, fb.watch

## Download with one link

Percent-encode the full video URL and pass it as `url`:

    GET https://wololo.edilson.dev/api/download?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3D379BagNcNf4

- `quality` is optional. Default: `720p`, meaning the best version available up to 720p (never upscaled).
- Other values: `360p`, `480p`, `720p`, `1080p`, or `mp3` for audio only.

    GET https://wololo.edilson.dev/api/download?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.youtube.com%2Fwatch%3Fv%3D379BagNcNf4&quality=mp3

Always percent-encode `url` (a raw `&` in the video URL would otherwise split it). Unknown query parameters are appended back to the video URL as a fallback.

## Responses

- `200`: the file itself, as an attachment (`Content-Disposition: attachment; filename=...`). `video/mp4` for video, `audio/mpeg` for `mp3`. Done.
- `202`: the download continues in the background (the server waits about 25 seconds before answering). JSON body:

      {"job_id": "...", "status": "downloading", "status_url": "/api/jobs/<job_id>",
       "download_url": "/api/jobs/<job_id>/download", "progress_url": "/api/jobs/<job_id>/progress",
       "retry_after_seconds": 5, "message": "..."}

- `400`: invalid or unsupported URL. `422`: the download failed (`detail` says why) or a parameter is invalid. `429`: rate limit (10 downloads per minute) or the queue is full; retry later.

## Following a job after 202

1. Every `retry_after_seconds` (5), `GET /api/jobs/<job_id>`. Watch `status` and `progress` (0-100).
   Status values: `queued`, `validating`, `downloading`, `converting`, `finalizing`, `completed`, `failed`, `cancelled`.
2. When `status` is `completed`, `GET /api/jobs/<job_id>/download` returns the file. Before that it answers `409`.
3. On `failed`, read `error_message`. On `cancelled`, start over.
4. Fetch the file soon: finished files are deleted after about 1 hour.

Long videos can take minutes; a job times out after 1 hour.

## Other endpoints

- `POST /api/download` with JSON `{"url": "...", "quality": "720p"}`: start a job and follow it as above.
- `POST /api/preview` with JSON `{"url": "..."}`: title, duration, thumbnail and available qualities without downloading.
- `GET /api/health`: service health and version.
- `GET /api/status`: current state and 90-day history of the service and of each platform (human view: /status).
- `DELETE /api/jobs/<job_id>`: cancel a job.

Use it only for content you have the right to download.
